notes: All 7 web searches ran (the six required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors); none returned any page where Brecheen speaks about AI. The search restricted to brecheen.house.gov returned only unrelated releases (FISA, IVF, service academies, 2025 Highlights). The 'AI safety' search surfaced Sen. Josh Hawley, a different person. From the earlier attempt (kept): his press release pages 1 and 2 (20 releases, 17 June 2025 to 3 August 2026) and News Hits page 1 (10 items, 24 June 2025 to 4 November 2025) show no AI title or excerpt; '2025 Highlights' (29 December 2025, https://brecheen.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=1543) and his 'Yes' vote statement on the One Big Beautiful Bill (3 July 2025, https://brecheen.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=1502) were read in full and do not mention AI or the proposed moratorium on state AI laws. This run re-opened press release page 1 (newest 3 August 2026) and again saw no AI titles; full texts of other releases were not read. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538): the FastDemocracy page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 House cosponsors, all Democrats, and Brecheen is not among them; Congress.gov returned 403 so the official list was not checked, and FastDemocracy may lag. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Floor speeches and hearing transcripts were not searched directly beyond what the web searches would surface.
